title: lbkit-skills.json
description: Optional repository-root skill manifest: skill chains registered by work type, referenced by lb-plan when drafting the 「技能：」 todo sub-line. Read and appended to by bin/lb skills.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor validation.

version.description: Manifest format version, a semantic version string.

name.description: Work type, semantically named, unique within the manifest.

scope.description: Scope of use, written as 「适用：…；不适用：…」 (applies-to / not-for), distinguished by the nature of the work — not replaced by action prefixes or repository names.

chain.description: Skill names in invocation order; may include skills that exist only inside a business repository.

actions.description: Common todo action prefixes (e.g. 设计, 开发); informational only, never used for mechanical matching.

companions.description: Skills used incidentally along the main skill chain, with no todo of their own.

description.description: Background for the next coordinator: prerequisites, how to run it, limits and what not to use, and the source logbook or work package.
